b: So, for whatever reason, I had this random thought „what did japanese people think about dinosaurs?“ Then, of course, i had to fact check. When did a fossil get identified as a dinosaur officially for the first time? Apparently in 1824, by a british man, yet japan only really opened up to foreigners in 1853-1854.

Do we know anything at all about this, like a japanese scholars reaction to this information, do any recorded thoughts/reactions to this exist at all? I dont know why, but this just keeps bugging me ever since I‘ve had this thought.
